sections.title: Classes
sections.text: Class 1 e-bikes assist up to 20 mph and only while you pedal. Class 2 add a throttle, also up to 20 mph. Class 3 assist up to 28 mph and suit long commutes on fast roads.

sections.title: Motors
sections.text: A mid-drive motor climbs hills better than a hub motor, because it drives through the bike's gears. For a hilly commute, choose a mid-drive.

sections.title: Batteries
sections.text: Most commuter batteries hold 400 to 750 Wh. At 15 to 25 Wh a mile, a 500 Wh battery gives 20 to 35 miles.
